exemplars.title: Exploring the impacts of semi-automated storytelling on programmers' comprehension of software histories
exemplars.why: This is the most literal realization of the pattern: an existing non-prose list view is explicitly converted by GPT-4 into a narrative paragraph that serves as the readable output.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: It ranks above ViSTAR because the evidence identifies the source representation, conversion operation, and terminal prose surface more completely.

exemplars.title: ViSTAR: Virtual Skill Training with Augmented Reality with 3D Avatars and LLM coaching agent
exemplars.why: ViSTAR maps spatio-temporal joint features—machine-readable measurements of physical movement—into concise natural-language coaching cues that users can immediately act upon.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: It ranks above EchoScriptor because its converted language is not merely descriptive but becomes actionable coaching, while still exposing the full feature-to-language mechanism.

exemplars.title: EchoScriptor: Automatic Lifelogging Narratives via Activity-Based Audio-Language Model
exemplars.why: EchoScriptor supplies an unusually concrete conversion pipeline: each ten-second audio segment becomes a short natural-language account of the activities and environmental sounds it contains.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: It ranks above RAVEN because the evidence explicitly identifies both the bounded source representation and the rendering step, whereas RAVEN's quote demonstrates the resulting scene description without establishing how the source scene is mapped to prose.

notes: I departed from the consensus by promoting rid 6267 from fourth to third and excluding rid 5807. RAVEN is highly consequential, but its quoted evidence shows a natural-language scene description without directly documenting the required source-to-prose mapping; EchoScriptor's evidence establishes that structure explicitly. The first two selections retain their consensus order. Readers should distrust strong claims about demonstrated impact: the evidence for rid 13939 is chiefly structural despite its comprehension framing, while the ViSTAR and EchoScriptor excerpts describe mechanisms but do not report measured outcome improvements. No score was adjusted by more than 0.3.
